::: {.lede}
i'm hannah! i'm a developmental psychologist interested in rules, procedures, groups, and (social) epistemologies of science.
:::

i'm a postdoctoral associate at MIT and Harvard, working with Rebecca Saxe in the
[Saxelab](https://saxelab.mit.edu/), Ashley Thomas in the Thomas Lab, and the
[Center for Research on Equitable & Open Scholarship](https://creos.mit.edu/) team in the
library. i did my doctoral work at the University of Chicago in the
[DIBS Lab](https://www.dibslab.uchicago.edu/) with Alex Shaw.

my [research](research.qmd) asks how children come to understand the toolkit that makes
collective life possible — how a group should decide, who should have a voice, and when shared
expectations need to become explicit rules.
